answer_1.quote: In this paper we use a more general definition that the entire architecture is optimized jointly and the translation is conducted in a more direct way... UnitY is a two‑pass direct S2ST model that subsequently generates both text and discrete unit outputs.
answer_1.outputs: Generated target speech waveform (via a unit‑based vocoder) and intermediate target text (subwords)

answer_2.quote: We use the sacrebleu toolkit to calculate the BLEU scores. ... We also calculated ASR‑chrF ... The results are presented ... UnitY achieved 2.51× decoding speed‑up over the S2SpecT2 and S2UT models.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted an audio‑only human evaluation to assess the translation quality while removing the necessity of ASR systems. We adopted cross‑lingual semantic textual similarity (XSTS) and percent acceptable translations. ... Three bilingual annotators evaluated each item and assigned it a score from one to five. The median score was taken per item.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged semantic similarity between source and translated sentence on a 1‑5 scale (XSTS) and a translation was considered acceptable if the score was ≥3. Percent acceptable translations were reported.
